lan-cmp-005.text: The Nile crocodile grows bigger than the saltwater crocodile. The saltwater crocodile can grow up to 12 meters in length, while the Nile crocodile reaches up to 16 meters [1].

st-boar-factbook-001.text: The capital of Kyrgyzstan is Bishkek, which has a population of approximately 900,000 (2005) [4]. The land is mountainous, with rugged terrain and significant elevation differences.

st-boar-factbook-004.text: Thimphu is the capital of Bhutan and has a population of about 700,000 [1]. The city's name comes from a legend about a mythical creature, the "Druk," which is the national symbol of Bhutan.

st-boar-factbook-007.text: Paraguay gets nearly all its power from dams, primarily hydroelectric facilities. It uses the Paraguayan currency, the "peso". The main exports are soybeans and beef [1].

st-boar-factbook-011.text: Western Sahara is currently controlled by the Sahrawi Arab Democratic Republic, recognized by over 82 countries [1]. The planned independence vote never occurred because Morocco, through the Green March, successfully asserted its claim, leading to the area's partition and Moroccan control.

st-boar-medlineplus-en-013.text: Ventricular tachycardia is the most common irregular heart rhythm diagnosed through an ECG [1]. The ECG detects abnormal electrical activity in the heart, specifically in the ventricles.

st-boar-simplewiki-en-016.text: Disney achieved the first animated feature film with a 3D animated opening crawl and the first live-action/animated musical. The film faced criticism for its portrayal of the character of the dog, which some felt was too stereotypical.

st-qa-bitcoin-se-018.text: Hardened derivation should be used for both the spend and scan keys in a BIP32/BIP44 wallet tree to ensure security and compatibility [1].

st-qa-cooking-se-007.text: Store green onions in a cool, dry place, such as a mesh bin or a container with holes, to allow air circulation. Avoid storing them in the fridge, as moisture can cause wilting. Use them as soon as possible after harvesting.

st-qa-ethereum-se-002.text: The ENS name renewal process is automatic once the expiration date is reached. You'll receive a renewal notice, and you can renew it before the expiration date to avoid loss. The registrar handles the renewal, so you don't need to take any action.

st-qa-money-se-012.text: No, earning additional pounds over the higher-rate threshold does not double your total income tax bill. The higher-rate threshold applies to income above £50,000, and any additional income beyond that is taxed at 40% rather than 32.5%.

st-qa-money-se-013.text: No, the expense ratio of a target-date fund is typically charged on top of the underlying funds' ratios.

st-qa-outdoors-se-009.text: Static ropes are typically chosen when climbing in environments where friction is important, such as in tight spaces or when using technical climbing techniques, as they provide better control and less slippage.

Sleeping under the stars in the Austrian mountains requires a clear sky, good campsite location, and proper gear to prevent cold and exposure. Use a sleeping bag and bring a blanket for warmth. Avoid using flashlights at night to reduce light pollution and preserve the natural darkness.

st-qa-travel-se-006.text: The Gatwick Express is the fastest way to Paddington from Gatwick Airport, with no stops between London Victoria and Gatwick [2]. Take the train to Paddington and transfer to the District Line for your journey.

st-qa-travel-se-010.text: You cannot turn euro notes into coins for parking meters in Italy. Parking meters require coins or electronic payments, and euro notes are not accepted. You should use real coins or a mobile payment method.

st-qa-travel-se-012.text: VAT back is possible for electronics purchased from Amazon UK in Ireland, but you must meet the eligibility criteria and submit the necessary documentation. The process may take some time, so plan accordingly.

st-qa-travel-se-018.text: Yes, someone in Sweden can use a cheap Romanian SIM card permanently if it's valid and accepted by the Swedish network operator, but roaming charges may apply [1].

Quadratic funding is a method used in decentralized finance (DeFi) to allocate funds based on community votes. Its main weakness is that it is vulnerable to collusion, as blockchain transactions are public and can be inspected to determine voting patterns.

vit-cry-007.text: D/acc is a digital-to-analog converter, which converts digital code to an analog signal [1]. It is the reverse of an analog-to-digital converter (ADC) [1].

vit-hum-004.text: Gríma Wormtongue kills Saruman in Isegard after Saruman's army attacks the fortress, and Gríma is later shot by hobbit archers [1].

lan-ref-002.text: The Union won the American Civil War [4]. The Confederacy was eventually defeated, leading to the abolition of slavery and the reunification of the United States.

lan-cmp-003.text: India is the seventh-largest country in the world by land area [5]. Several countries are larger than India by area, including Russia, Canada, Brazil, and Australia.

st-boar-factbook-013.text: Trinidad and Tobago gained independence from the United Kingdom on August 31, 1962 [1]. The country's economy has been dominated by the petroleum industry for more than a century.

st-boar-medlineplus-en-020.text: Vaccines generally have mild side effects, and serious side effects are very rare [1]. There is no credible scientific evidence linking vaccines to autism or other serious conditions. Vaccines are one of the most effective ways to prevent deadly diseases.

st-boar-simplewiki-en-007.text: In 793, a Viking raid on Lindisfarne terrified the island, and the monks fled [3]. They took Saint Cuthbert's remains with them, which are now buried at Durham Cathedral [3].

lan-exp-003.text: Kenya is in East Africa, near the Horn of Africa, and its capital is Nairobi [3]. The official languages are English and Swahili, and Kenya gained independence in 1963.

st-qa-outdoors-se-008.text: A nor'easter is named because the storm's winds come from the northeast, not the southwest [1]. The name reflects the direction of the winds, not the storm's origin.

st-boar-medlineplus-en-007.text: The CDC advises pregnant women not to travel to areas with Zika virus outbreaks due to the risk of transmitting the virus to their fetuses [1]. Zika virus can cause birth defects and neurological problems [3]. Prevention measures include using bug spray and wearing long sleeves.

st-boar-simplewiki-en-003.text: Cosmogony focuses on the origin of the universe, while cosmology studies the universe in general [2]. Science cannot describe the first instant of the universe due to the lack of a testable theory of quantum gravity.

st-boar-simplewiki-en-015.text: The name "Google" is a play on the word "googol," meaning a number with 100 zeros [4]. Google earns money by showing targeted advertisements to users, based on their online activity and data collected through services like Google Analytics [2].

st-qa-bitcoin-se-005.text: Bitcoin Core is a full node that requires significant resources and is not designed to mine coins. It will not earn you coins on its own. You need a mining pool or a dedicated mining rig for that purpose.

A triangular head is not a reliable way to determine if a snake is venomous, as many non-venomous snakes also have triangular heads. Venomosity is determined by other characteristics, such as the snake's habitat, size, and behavior.

st-boar-factbook-010.text: Hong Kong's economy is driven by finance, trade, and services, with the financial sector being a major contributor. The Hong Kong dollar (HKD) is currently worth approximately HK$7.80 per US dollar, according to the official exchange rate [2].

st-qa-bitcoin-se-015.text: An ASIC miner is a specialized computer chip designed for Bitcoin mining [1]. It is much more efficient at mining than a regular computer because it is tailored to perform the specific task of mining Bitcoin, which involves complex calculations. This makes ASIC miners significantly faster and more cost-effective for mining. [1]

st-qa-travel-se-016.text: Get enough sleep before departure, stay hydrated, and avoid heavy meals. Once in Beirut, adjust your sleep schedule gradually and stay in a bright, consistent light environment to help your body adjust to the new time zone.

st-qa-bitcoin-se-013.text: A lightweight SPV wallet verifies payments by checking only the block headers, while a full node validates the entire blockchain [1]. This makes SPV wallets faster and more convenient but less secure, as they rely on full nodes for trust.

st-qa-money-se-018.text: Leasing a car offers convenience and lower upfront costs, but you don't build equity. Buying a car gives you ownership and long-term savings, though it requires a larger initial payment.

st-qa-travel-se-015.text: Keep your camera and lenses in a protective case, use a shoulder strap for comfort, and carry them in a breathable bag to avoid heat damage.

st-boar-medlineplus-en-019.text: Keep your emergency kit in the car, include blankets, flashlights, batteries, and a first-aid kit. Stay informed about road conditions and avoid driving in severe weather [2].

st-qa-outdoors-se-005.text: No, drinkable liquor should not be used to clean wounds. It can cause irritation and damage to the skin and tissues. Instead, use clean water or a saline solution.
